final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS o FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS mean_avg_net_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - overall.o) AS mean_excess FROM per_order p, overall WHERE p.avg_net > overall.o
